objective: Finish own receipt-driven development: the tasks of odd/tasks/own-rdd.md that are not checked off, so that our review lifecycle stands alone before gentle-ai's review is removed.
scope: The specs of odd/tasks/own-rdd.md that those tasks name; one workflow and one role chain for each task.
constraints: Finished tasks of odd/tasks/own-rdd.md are not redone.
The builder builds only a task the shaper designed (S14).
Every commit is reviewed or exempted, and labdrian review check clears it (S5, S6).
non_goals: Removing gentle-ai review, its hooks, lens agents and engine/reviewreceipt.
acceptance_criteria: T17, T7, T9, T8 and T12 of odd/tasks/own-rdd.md are checked off, each with its commit.
labdrian review check --base clears the head of each task's pull request.
runtime_scope: Claude Code, Codex and Pi, as the specs of odd/tasks/own-rdd.md name them.
delivery_boundary: Work-unit commits on the branches of odd/tasks/own-rdd.md; push, pull requests and merges are the owner's decisions.
